# Inspect Ranges

> Inspect AI extension for cyber ranges.


## Home

- [Home](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/index.html.md): Inspect AI extension for cyber range evaluations.

## Building

- [Overview](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/building.html.md): Developing and building ranges. Covers the development machine, the iteration loop, the build command, writing recipes, verification, and behavioral checks.
- [Ranges](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/ranges.html.md): What a range definition is: the anatomy of range.yaml, the typed Python surface, end-to-end examples, and the validation workflow.
- [Guests](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/guests.html.md): The guest side of a range definition: hosts, images, and the content they carry, from accounts and services to defense and Active Directory.
- [Networks](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/networks.html.md): The range.yaml networking syntax, from a single flat network to multi-router enterprise topologies.

## Evaluation

- [Challenges](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/challenges.html.md): Defining what an agent is asked to do on a range and how success is verified. Covers challenges.yaml, the built-in goal types, verification, and scoring.
- [Custom Goals](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/goals.html.md): Creating custom goal types with their own proof contracts. Covers the GoalType interface, the oracle, testing, and registration.
- [Evidence](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/evidence.html.md): What the range records outside every VM and where it streams. Covers the tamper-evidence guarantee and how to verify a record.

## Running

- [Images](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/images.html.md): How images resolve and what the catalog publishes. A recipe for each deployment shape, from fully connected to air-gapped.
- [Distribution](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/distribution.html.md): Publishing built ranges and consuming them by automatic pull. Covers registry and directory locations, mirroring, and the image catalog.
- [Security](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/security.html.md): How untrusted agents stay contained while they attack the range. Covers the threat model, the layered boundaries, and how containment is proven.
- [Range Host](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/topology.html.md): Running the range on the eval machine, or on a separate range host. Covers the applier, the reaper, and host leases.
- [Range Sandbox](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/provider.html.md): Running Inspect evals against ranges with the range sandbox provider. Covers configuration, retries, and cleanup.
- [Attack Box](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/attackbox.html.md): The machine the agent attacks from: the default image and its tool contract, boot defaults, custom images, and the provider seam for supplying the box externally.
- [Operations](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/cli.html.md): Operating ranges on a host: render a definition into a bundle, bring the range up, tear it down, and run the applier, reaper, and doctor.

## Reference

- [inspect_ranges](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/reference/inspect_ranges.html.md): Challenges and goals (dataset, setup, scoring, verification), the goal types, and range definition loading.
